chapters.title: Chapter 2073: Those limitations do not apply to me.
paragraphs: "I have a way."
He spoke,
"A sure-shot way to win and put an end to the arrogant Sharnoth once and for all."
Nux offered, like a demon suggesting a pure, ignorant soul to take his offer.
"A sure-shot way...?"
And the pure, ignorant soul took the bait, just as Nux wanted him to. Finally, the past 10 minutes he had spent on these people were going to give him what he wanted.
"What way?"
Vexarion questioned, unable to control himself any longer.
"In Khaemorr’s statement, they said that they will leave the battle’s structure of accord to Aurendor, correct?"
Nux began. Vexarion nodded at those words.
"This means the time and place of the battle will be decided by you."
"That is correct, but they used the words Herald of Justice. If your plan is to do something to the battle place that will give me an advantage, then forget about it.
If Khaemorr finds out about it, the consequences will be dire."
"I know that, don’t worry."
Nux nodded.
Aurendor was part of the Faction of Light. He had to keep an upright reputation like his life depended on it—because it actually did.
To a being from the Faction of Light, a bad reputation was no different from death. There were times when the Supreme World of Light acted on its own to ’remove’ the stain on its reputation.
Exposing their lies and ruining their reputation was actually one of the strongest weapons used in battle against Worlds from the Faction of Light.
Nux knew all that. He knew Aurendor had to choose a fair battle place, and most likely, it would be a neutral Dead World where the two opponents could go all out.
"I just want one thing."
Nux spoke.
"What is it?"

"Choose a Dead World that will only allow two foreign entities. If any other entity tries to enter, the entire world shall tremble, alerting every being watching the situation from outside. This will ensure that Sharnoth will have no support in the battle."
"There are such worlds in the Universe, yes. It can be done."
Vexarion nodded.
Nux nodded back.
Of course, there were such Dead Worlds in the Universe. This was the reason he was suggesting all this in the first place.
"It would be better if the Dead World doesn’t have any other High Level or Supreme Worlds around it as well."
"That can be done as well."
Vexarion nodded again.
"No spectators will be allowed. You can say that you do not want your battle to impact others."
Nux made another demand.
"It won’t be possible. Since the matter has become this big, there will be spectators."
"We can broadcast the battle throughout the Universe in real-time. Spectators can watch from their respective worlds. I am sure you have the power to arrange that."
"I do."
Vexarion nodded again.
"But... why go this far?
What’s the point? No one is going to help Sharnoth anyway. She is the Heir to Chaos. Helping her would directly put them against the Supreme Worlds. No one is foolish enough to—"
"Do you truly think it is possible for an eleven-year-old girl to escape Aurendor without external help?"
Suddenly, Nux asked a question, and in an instant, Vexarion’s expression changed.
He obviously knew that someone had helped Sharnoth, but all this time, he believed it was Nocthys remnants or their allies.
He tried looking into it, but it wasn’t exactly easy since the little girl left no trace or leads.
"What are you trying to say?"

"I am saying there are people helping her—people with extraordinary means. If they have the power to make an eleven-year-old Sharnoth escape from right under your nose, then they aren’t enemies you should take lightly.
We need to ensure Sharnoth does not have any external help."

Vexarion nodded at those words with a solemn look on his face. It was still difficult to believe that there might be beings who were prepared to go against the Supreme Worlds, but honestly, it wasn’t that difficult to believe.
Especially considering Sharnoth used the Power of Chaos.
It wouldn’t be surprising if the remnants of the Fifth Supreme World still existed.
"...are we going against—"
Vexarion’s face turned solemn. If they were indeed up against the remnants of Chaos, that would make things much more complicated.
He would rather have the Supreme World of Light take care of the matter.
"Even if it’s them, they will not show themselves in front of you. If they had that sort of power, they would have done it a long time ago. Stop worrying about it."
Nux reassured confidently.
Obviously, Vexarion wasn’t convinced, so Nux just sighed and,
"Sharnoth is stronger than you.

She has every reason to believe she will be able to defeat you in a one-on-one battle. The real reason I want you to choose such a world is to show her that you actually intend to fight her in a fair, one-on-one battle.

Do not worry, those people will not make a move because they are confident in her. But once you defeat her and give her to the Supreme World of Light, you can seek their protection. They will not let anything happen to you since you will then become the Face of the Light Faction in front of Chaos, linking you to their reputation.
And you know how much those beings care about their reputation."
"All I hear is that I will be turned into a glorified target."
Vexarion wasn’t a fool. He could see how all of this would work out.
"You are already a target, Vexarion."
Nux spoke with a solemn look on his face.
"I am turning you into a glorified target because the possibility of a glorified target surviving is higher than a normal target that no one cares about."
Vexarion turned silent, staring at Nux.
Nux stared back. He had already sensed Vexarion’s desperation, so he knew where this conversation would be going.
And just as he expected,
"Even if I do follow your plan and participate in a one-on-one battle against Sharnoth,
You just said she is stronger than me,
So how am I supposed to win?"
"I will appear and help you."
Nux declared confidently.
"Huh? How will you help me? You just said to choose a world where only two beings can enter."
Vexarion was confused, but Nux...
He just smiled,
"Those limitations do not apply to me."
"What does tha—"
Before Vexarion could even say anything, suddenly, he noticed Nux’s body flicker and then disappear.
He frowned in confusion, but then suddenly, his eyes widened in horror as he sensed a horrifying amount of energy gathering behind him.
He turned around, wanting to react to this, but—
It was already too late.
SLASH
His left arm was cut clean, and he...
He still did not understand what had happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 2074: Do you understand what you have to do now?
paragraphs: "How will you help me? You just said to choose a world where only two beings can enter."
Vexarion questioned with a confused look on his face.
Nux, however, just smiled as suddenly, Bloodedge appeared in his hand. Vexarion could only see the upper half of his body, so he had no clue what was happening.
Bzzz
His Bloodedge buzzed, as if she was greeting him. The trusted sword had already started sucking Nux’s energy even when he hadn’t used it yet.
Nux’s smile widened.
’I missed you too.’
He greeted back as suddenly, he infused half of his total energy into his sword.
BZZZ

Bloodedge flared up. By now, Nux had devoured hundreds of different worlds, the amount of energy he had access to right now was probably higher than most beings present in the entirety of the Universe.
And when half of this absurdly large energy pool was infused into Bloodedge, the sword was no different than death itself.
She was prepared—
—prepared to cut anyone who came in front of her.
Nux, who sensed his sword’s emotions, smiled even more brightly and—
"Those limitations do not apply to me."
He answered Vexarion’s question.
"What does tha—"
Before the Herald of Truth could even understand what he was talking about, Nux teleported and appeared a few meters beside him.
BZZZ
Bloodedge flared one last time before all the energy she had gathered was released in an instant and—
SLASH
Vexarion’s left arm was cut clean and Nux disappeared, returning to where he was, where Vexarion could not sense or find him.
Vexarion let out a confused voice.
Was he in pain?
Yes, he was.
But he was an Eternal. Even though he usually avoided direct battles, it did not mean he had never fought before. One could not reach his level by simply avoiding battles. Vexarion was talented.
Heck, he was one of the few beings with an Absolute Law. Even though he was in pain, it wasn’t enough for him to lose his mind,
Especially not when...
This happened to him.
Whatever ’this’ was.
The very next second, Vexarion extended his domain, taking control over everything around him.
He did not understand what had just happened. His body, however, acted on its own as he took control over the area around him and started looking around with a wary look on his face.

He even restricted the movements of whoever was in his domain to make sure he wasn’t taken by surprise. Of course, he also commanded his severed arm to return to its position, and as the God of his domain, what he wished happened, and his arm was reattached.
Yes, just like that, Nux’s attack was rendered ineffective, and Vexarion had returned to his full strength.

This was also the reason despite having a way to harm Eternals, Nux couldn’t actually kill them. Let alone Vexarion, who could still be considered strong compared to normal Eternals, he couldn’t even take out a weaker Eternal simply because all the damage he does would be nullified by their single command.

Even if he took an Eternal by surprise using his Space Law like he did with Vexarion and cut off his head instead of his arm, the Eternal’s mind would still be active for enough time to activate his domain and nullify the damage.
And once an Eternal is aware of Nux, the battle becomes impossible since he would be able to keep his domain active, making it impossible for Nux to even get close, let alone harm him.
Of course, Nux obviously knew all that. He never attacked to harm Vexarion in the first place. His goal was something else—
"That was an appropriate response."
He spoke calmly as he reappeared on the screen in front of Vexarion.
Vexarion glared at him in anger. He was prepared to lash out, but suddenly—
"This is how I will help you in your battle against Sharnoth."
The Herald of Justice was taken aback as suddenly—
"I came and attacked you. Why do you think the Will of Aurendor did not alert you of a foreigner’s invasion?"
Nux asked a question, and in an instant, Vexarion’s expression changed as he realized it as well.
A question popped into his head.
How did Aurendor’s Will not warn him? ree
Was this bastard not a foreigner but belonged to Aurendor?
No, Vexarion quickly disregarded that possibility.
That wasn’t possible. Even if he was from Aurendor, there was no way Aurendor would miss him. Even if it wouldn’t alert him, at the very least, it would be able to sense him.
But...
Even now, according to Aurendor’s Will, nothing had happened. According to it, no being other than his subordinates had gotten close to him.
It...
It completely missed this man’s movements.
It was almost as if...
"Worlds’ Wills cannot sense my presence."
Nux said what Vexarion was thinking, and even when he heard it and saw it with his own eyes, Vexarion still couldn’t believe this absurdity.
Just thinking about its implication and what this man could do with such power overwhelmed his mind.
Just... what kind of monster was he dealing with?
Vexarion thought inwardly. For some reason, his left arm that was chopped off started trembling.
It wasn’t just him. The rest of his subordinates who heard those words and saw how their leader was attacked right in front of their eyes were frozen in fear and shock.
Nux, who saw their reaction, completely ignored their shock. This wasn’t the first time this had happened to him anyway; he had long gotten used to such looks.
"Do you understand what you have to do now?"
He questioned, attracting Vexarion’s attention.
"The Dead World you choose wouldn’t be able to sense my presence. It wouldn’t react even if I interfered with your battle.
Accept Khaemorr’s offer, choose the world according to the conditions I just mentioned, give Khaemorr a day to inspect and explore that world.
Show them that you are prepared for a fair battle and on the day of the battle,
Clash your domain with Sharnoth’s and it would allow me to appear next to her, deal critical damage to her, and you can use this chance to get rid of her or capture her alive.
Is that clear?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2075: We are a very vindictive family.
paragraphs: "Show them that you are prepared for a fair battle and on the day of the battle,
Clash your domain with Sharnoth’s and it would allow me to appear next to her, deal critical damage to her, and you can use this chance to get rid of her or capture her alive,
Is that clear?"
Nux instructed and Vexarion...
He still couldn’t believe this was happening.
Was this... really possible?
Could he... actually defeat Sharnoth?
Could he actually defeat the Heir to Chaos and get the Supreme World of Light’s favor?
Even now, all of this felt like a dream. The ability that this man just showed seemed too good to be true, but slowly, it all started to make sense.
This was how the Leander Family was able to become the threat they were now.
But even then, Vexarion wasn’t convinced,
"All this feels too suspicious."
He muttered.
"What is it now?"
Nux questioned, somewhat annoyed.
Just how paranoid was this man?
How did he manage to become the Leader of a High-Level World with such an attitude? Everything was being served in front of him on a silver platter, yet he was still hesitant.
Just what in the hell was wrong with him?

"Sharnoth has challenged me to a Death Match before as well, and because I knew her Faction wouldn’t make it a fair battle, I denied it. If I accept her challenge this easily now, she will be suspicious. She might not even participate in the battle."
Vexarion mentioned a problem.
"That won’t happen."
Nux shook his head.
"Why is that?"
"You should know that more than me, shouldn’t you?"
Nux questioned back and Vexarion turned silent.
For an instant, he recalled that little girl glaring at him with pure, unhidden hatred.
"The only reason Sharnoth moves is because of her hatred for you. She will do anything in her power if she gets to kill you with her own hands, even if that means her death."
Nux answered as he looked into Vexarion’s eyes.
Vexarion stayed silent and Nux continued,
"That woman isn’t a fool. She knew what she was getting into when she revealed her Power of Chaos.
She knows she is surrounded. She knows she wouldn’t survive, so even if you have set up a trap, she will still come and try to get her revenge.
She is that desperate.
Use that desperation to your advantage, Vexarion. This is the only chance you will get."
Nux spoke with a convincing look on his face, and this time, Vexarion couldn’t deny his words.
He just had one more question,
"Where do you stand in all this?"
He questioned as he looked into Nux’s eyes.
"What do you mean?"
Nux questioned back.

"You appear out of nowhere and start attacking Sharnoth’s Faction, you weaken it to the point that she desperately reveals her trump card—a card that would get her killed eventually—but then suddenly, you stop targeting her and target her enemies instead.
What does the Leander Family want? What is your goal? My men have been trying to talk to you all this while. Why did you only approach us now?"
Vexarion questioned.
It was a logical line of thought. From his perspective, the Leander Family’s actions made next to no sense.
Was the Leander Family an ally or an enemy? He couldn’t see through it.
"As I said before, we are merely mercenaries chasing profits."
"Profits...?"
Aurendor narrowed his eyes.
"Weakening Khaemorr’s Faction profited us, so we did what we did. Once we had weakened them enough, our job was done.
We would have disappeared, but then we were told to attack you. Since we saw the profits, we began targeting you.
And now we are once again targeting you because we see profit in that."
Nux answered as if it was obvious.
"Weakening Khaemorr’s Faction profited you? How? Who hired you? My Faction is the only one that Khaemorr’s Faction is up against. Who else but us would hire you?"
"I have no reason to reveal that."
Nux shook his head.
"You do.
If you wish to win my trust, you must reveal it."
Vexarion didn’t give in, and Nux was the same.
"You are mistaking something here, Vexarion Aurendor.
You are the one who needs me, not the other way around.
You wanted to know why we did not contact you before this, correct? It is because we knew you were incompetent. We have done our research.
The only reason we are contacting you now is because of Sharnoth’s actions.
She is desperate to have her revenge, so you are an ideal choice, but this does not make you the only choice. Accept her offer or not, without our help your situation will only get worse from here.
As for Sharnoth,
We will help someone else capture her and get the profits we are after."
Nux declared with a confident look on his face.
Vexarion stayed silent for a moment. He didn’t like how he had no control over this man at all. Now, however, the enemy wasn’t the ghostly shadow he knew nothing about,
Now, he had something.
"You already showed me your trump card, have you not? What if I reveal your secret to the Universe?"
He threatened with a wide grin.
"Sure, try that."
Nux chuckled, unbothered.
"Quite a genius approach, I must say.
You will be surrounded by different enemies after this anyway. One more wouldn’t make any difference, now would it?
What’s the worst that could happen?
We will only make it so you are completely isolated to the point even your most loyal subordinates would leave you.
I am sure the absence of the Faction you raised with so much effort wouldn’t affect you much, right?"
Nux smiled ’politely.’
"Are you threatening me?"
Vexarion narrowed his eyes.
"Oh no no, this is not a threat.
Don’t misunderstand."
Nux shook his head.
Then, his purple eyes turned cold and,
"This is prediction."
He declared.
"Try and go against us and we will do everything in our power to hasten your end.
Trust me when I say it,
We are a very vindictive family."

"That woman isn’t a fool.
She knew what she was getting into when she revealed her Power of Chaos.
She knows she is surrounded.
She knows she wouldn’t survive, so even if you have set up a trap, she will still come and try to get her revenge.
She is that desperate.
Use that desperation to your advantage, Vexarion.
This is the only chance you will get."
Nux spoke with a convincing look on his face, and this time, Vexarion couldn’t deny his words.
He just had one more question,
"Where do you stand in all this?"
He questioned as he looked into Nux’s eyes.
"What do you mean?"
Nux questioned back.

"You appear out of nowhere and start attacking Sharnoth’s Faction, you weaken it to the point that she desperately reveals her trump card—a card that would get her killed eventually—but then suddenly, you stop targeting her and target her enemies instead.
What does the Leander Family want?
What is your goal?
My men have been trying to talk to you all this while.
Why did you only approach us now?"
Vexarion questioned.
It was a logical line of thought.
From his perspective, the Leander Family’s actions made next to no sense.
Was the Leander Family an ally or an enemy?
He couldn’t see through it.
"As I said before, we are merely mercenaries chasing profits."
"Profits...?"
Aurendor narrowed his eyes.
"Weakening Khaemorr’s Faction profited us, so we did what we did.
Once we had weakened them enough, our job was done.
We would have disappeared, but then we were told to attack you.
Since we saw the profits, we began targeting you.
And now we are once again targeting you because we see profit in that."
Nux answered as if it was obvious.
"Weakening Khaemorr’s Faction profited you?
How?
Who hired you?
My Faction is the only one that Khaemorr’s Faction is up against.
Who else but us would hire you?"
"I have no reason to reveal that."
Nux shook his head.
"You do.
If you wish to win my trust, you must reveal it."
Vexarion didn’t give in, and Nux was the same.
"You are mistaking something here, Vexarion Aurendor.
You are the one who needs me, not the other way around.
You wanted to know why we did not contact you before this, correct?
It is because we knew you were incompetent.
We have done our research.
The only reason we are contacting you now is because of Sharnoth’s actions.
She is desperate to have her revenge, so you are an ideal choice, but this does not make you the only choice.
Accept her offer or not, without our help your situation will only get worse from here.
As for Sharnoth,
We will help someone else capture her and get the profits we are after."
Nux declared with a confident look on his face.
Vexarion stayed silent for a moment.
He didn’t like how he had no control over this man at all.
Now, however, the enemy wasn’t the ghostly shadow he knew nothing about,
Now, he had something.
"You already showed me your trump card, have you not?
What if I reveal your secret to the Universe?"
He threatened with a wide grin.
"Sure, try that."
Nux chuckled, unbothered.
"Quite a genius approach, I must say.
You will be surrounded by different enemies after this anyway.
One more wouldn’t make any difference, now would it?
What’s the worst that could happen?
We will only make it so you are completely isolated to the point even your most loyal subordinates would leave you.
I am sure the absence of the Faction you raised with so much effort wouldn’t affect you much, right?"
Nux smiled ’politely.’
"Are you threatening me?"
Vexarion narrowed his eyes.
"Oh no no, this is not a threat.
Don’t misunderstand."
Nux shook his head.
Then, his purple eyes turned cold and,
"This is prediction."
He declared.
"Try and go against us and we will do everything in our power to hasten your end.
Trust me when I say it,
We are a very vindictive family."

chapters.title: Chapter 2076: Something’s wrong here.
paragraphs: "Oh no no, this is not a threat.
Don’t misunderstand."
Nux shook his head.
"This is prediction.
Try and go against us and we will do everything in our power to hasten your end.
Trust me when I say it,
We are a very vindictive family."
Nux spoke as his purple eyes shined coldly and Vexarion...
He had no answer to those words.
He had seen what the Leander Family did to Khaemorr and its Faction. Khaemorr was so isolated that it allowed him to recruit even the most loyal worlds to his Faction.
What’s worse was that the Leander Family did all that in less than a month. Khaemorr was completely helpless, even sending its elites to take action did not change anything.
It was... terrifying.

And even though Vexarion often laughed at Khaemorr and Sharnoth for not being able to take care of a ’mere’ mercenary party, deep down, he knew even he would have a difficult time finding a way to neutralize the threat.
After all, the ability to not be recognized by a World’s Will combined with that mastery over Space, it was almost impossible to counter.
Even he got hurt by an attack, that too, in his own World— not many beings could do that and get away without a scratch.
What’s even worse is that this bastard didn’t even look tired. It was as if he was simply showing the difference in strength between the two.
Even if he revealed the Leander Family’s secret to the rest of the Universe, it wouldn’t make them any less of a threat, after all, there were very limited ways to counterattack them.
Honestly, it was very likely that by the time Vexarion found the solution and neutralized them, the damage would already be something out of his control.
It was indeed foolish to antagonize these people without any apparent reason.
In the end, Vexarion controlled himself. Yes, even someone as arrogant as him gave in to this man’s threat. It was humiliating, but he still needed him to be on his side.
"You attacked my subordinate worlds."
After a minute-long silence, Vexarion mentioned.
"As I said w—"
"You did it for profit, I understand that."
Vexarion interrupted.
"I will not find faults in that, every being does whatever he can to survive, it is the simple Law of the Universe. The weak are bound to become prey for the strong."
The Herald of Justice declared coldly. He then looked into Nux’s eyes and,
"I will not ask who hired you to attack us or any other details regarding what you did, as you said, you have no reason to reveal that.
But that does not change the fact that you changed sides and acted against me and in favor of my enemies.
Before I ally myself with you,
I need you to prove to me that you are not on the enemy’s side.
If you cannot do that, let us peacefully end the conversation here."
He spoke in a tone that made it clear that no further negotiations were needed. The Herald of Justice had taken his stance, and he had no plans of backing down.
Honestly, from everything Nux knew about him after reading memories of those he kidnapped, he didn’t think the conversation would continue for so long.
Fooling Vexarion was much more difficult than he was initially expecting.
’He isn’t a Leader of a High-Level World without a reason, huh.’
He praised in his head, for now, however, he just smiled and used the biggest card he had been saving all this time,
"Are you asking me to prove that I am not on the enemy’s side?"
He questioned back, looking surprised that Vexarion said those words.
"Yes."
Vexarion nodded, completely ignoring Nux’s shocked face.
"Do you think I am a fool?"
Nux blinked. It was as if he couldn’t understand the situation, soon however, his expression turned hostile,
"What are you trying to do, Vexarion?"
"What are you talking about?"
Now, it was Vexarion’s turn to be confused.
"You tell me!"
Nux raised his hand at the absurdity of the situation,
"You just asked me to prove that I am not on Sharnoth’s side.
Who in his right mind would currently be on Sharnoth’s side when she is bound to become an enemy of the Supreme Worlds?
She is nothing more than a Universal Target, someone every being in the Universe wishes to capture so they could get close to the Supreme Worlds.
Why in the seven hells would I be on her side?"
Nux snapped and Vexarion...
He turned silent.
Nux’s words made sense. No one in his right mind would side with that woman right now. Vexarion couldn’t even think of that possibility.
The only way this could go wrong would be this man attacking him instead of Sharnoth, allowing Sharnoth to kill him and then helping someone else capture Sharnoth to get the prize.

But that would make no sense since he had no particular reason to move against him, not to mention he would also be giving his weakness to the being he helped by giving him the proof that he actually helped Sharnoth when everyone knew she was the Universe’s enemy.
As he thought about it, Vexarion nodded to himself.
Then, he glanced at Nux and,
"Alright then, what do you want in return for my help?"
"Ten High-Level Relics."
Nux’s answer was instantaneous.
"WHAT!?"
Vexarion snapped.
"Ten High-Level Relics."
Nux repeated with an indifferent look on his face.
"Have you lost your mind!?"
"I have not."
"Do you even know how valuable Ten High-Level Relics are!?"
"You talk as if you do not know the value of what I am providing you."
Nux replied.
He then looked into Vexarion’s eyes and,
"I ask this because I know you have the resources to give me what I want. I wouldn’t have demanded it otherwise."
Vexarion’s face turned sore.
"You read Darage’s memories."
Darage was one of his oldest subordinates, one who disappeared in the recent incident of his Transcendents disappearing mysteriously.
If it was Darage, he must have known how much wealth he had gathered since he was the one who managed most of it.
"As I said, we do our research before making a move."
Nux answered without a change in his expression and Vexarion clenched his fists in annoyance.

"You will give me seven of those Relics now before your battle with Sharnoth, and the rest after you win against Sharnoth. You can choose which ones to give right now and which ones later. I do not care for that, since I know I will be getting all of them."
"No, I will give you three Relics right now, the rest later."
Vexarion countered and Nux just stared at the man with an annoyed look on his face,
"We both know you need this more than me.
Why are you making this overly complicated?"
He questioned.
Vexarion turned silent and Nux—
"Now, keep the seven Relics in front of you. I will use my powers to take them. Do it quickly, I do not have all day."
—he instructed.
It was annoying, but what was even more annoying was that Vexarion had no choice but to follow the instructions.

He did as he was told and told the seven worst High-Level Relics he had. Nux waved his hand and in an instant, all the Relics disappeared right in front of the Herald of Justice, making his heart bleed.
The deal was made.
Nux smiled lightly as he stared at the seven Relics hovering around him. As a precaution, he had also sealed the Space around him, making teleportation impossible.
"Good doing business with you."
With a wave of his hand, a Call Artifact appeared in front of Vexarion and,
"If you wish to contact me again, use this."
He muttered and finally, he cut the call without letting Vexarion speak anything else.
After the call ended, deathly silence fell onto Vexarion’s Hall. None of his subordinates dared to speak; they all knew how annoyed their Lord was.
"Leave."
After a short while, Vexarion ordered and in an instant, his subordinates scrammed.
On the other side, Nux, who was currently playing with the Relics in his hand with a smile on his face, was suddenly greeted by two adorable cats who jumped into his arms.
"Why did you ask for these things when they are of no use to us? He could have turned down the offer because of your extreme demand."
Rune questioned as she buried herself inside Nux’s robes and licked his chest.
They couldn’t activate the Relics because that would give away their information to the Supreme World of Eternity. To them, these artifacts were no different than stone.
Nux, however, shook his head.
"If I hadn’t made this outrageous demand, he wouldn’t have trusted me."
He chuckled.
"You are too cruel, not only are you going to kill him, you are also going to take away the wealth he had gained after working all his life."
Thyra chuckled as she licked Nux’s ears. Yes, the cat was trying to stimulate him and pull him into her bed.
Nux rubbed her body and laughed out loud,
"The dead have no need for treasures, do they?"
He questioned.
The two cats laughed with him as they made themselves comfortable, acting however they wanted because they knew Nux would catch them.
Nux, of course, obliged and did exactly what they expected him to.
How could he not give in to such temptation? He could already imagine the two naked cat girls in his bed and just as he was about to grin ear to ear,
’Master Nux.’
A subordinate called out.
’What is it?’
Nux questioned with a frown, recalling where he had placed this one.
’Something’s wrong here.’
The subordinate answered, and before he could explain anything further,
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe reacted angrily.
The Reaper’s Veil hiding Umbrasol disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 2077: The Universe’s Anger.
paragraphs: ’Master Nux.’
One of Nux’s subordinates called out.
’What is it?’
Nux questioned with a frown.
He had placed so many subordinates in so many places that it was impossible to keep track of them all.
’Something’s wrong here.’
’Where?’
Nux questioned.
’The Reaper’s Veil.’
The instant the man said those words, Nux’s expression changed. He, who was drifting in Outer Space, cuddling with his cats leisurely, suddenly sat up and,
’What happ—’
He tried to question, but—
It was already too late.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe reacted.
This time, much more strongly than ever before. Even the Outer Space Nux was in, an area usually unaffected by such reactions, wasn’t spared.
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
Asteroids floating around burst into pieces. The impact of their explosion travelled far and wide.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
And the Universe’s anger did not resolve here; it continued to rumble, destroying everything it could. It felt like it was preparing to self-destruct.
It was clear how angry it was.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
"Nux, what did you do?"
Thyra, who was seeing everything happen right in front of her, turned towards her husband. She didn’t even think about there being another being capable of enraging the Universe to this level.
"I was with you the entire time..."
Nux tried to defend himself, but the cat just stared at him with her hypnotic blue eyes. It wasn’t just her—the white cat beside her was staring at Nux with her green eyes as well.
"...let me find out what I did."
Nux just admitted it as he once again diverted his focus to the subordinate who had contacted him.
’What happened?’
He questioned again.
But...
There was no answer.
Nux narrowed his eyes.
He closed his eyes and tried to sense his subordinate’s presence, but...
He no longer existed in this Universe.
He had perished.
Nux knew he was stationed near Umbrasol so that he could inform him the moment something happened. He tried to contact other such subordinates near Umbrasol and realized all of them had disappeared.
It didn’t take long for him to understand what had happened,
’The Universe must have attacked them.’
The instant Reaper’s Veil disappeared, the Universe must have bombed the entire area in hopes of catching the Anomaly.
Or at least that was what Nux theorized, and considering how angry the Universe was right now, it was indeed very much possible.
"What is it?"
Rune questioned.

The Universe still hadn’t stopped reacting; the trembling still continued. She could still feel the heat of the explosions that just happened. She contacted other subordinates planted in different regions of the Universe and realized that asteroids all over the Universe had exploded.
Only a few absurdly large asteroids were spared.
It was a major incident where billions and billions of lives were lost. Some Low and Lowest Level Worlds were ruined completely, degrading them to their earliest state, a state with no life forms.
It was horrifying.
And...
It was safe to assume that they wouldn’t be able to have fun for now, at least not until they understood what happened, so both Rune and Thyra returned to their usual forms.
"I think something happened to the Reaper’s Veil."
Nux answered. Even he had a solemn look on his face.
"Reaper’s Veil?"
Thyra frowned.
"Did it disappear?"
Rune questioned.
"Most likely."
Nux nodded.
"That makes sense."
Thyra muttered.
The Reaper’s Veil hid the fact that Nux had devoured Umbrasol from the Universe. If it disappeared, then the Universe must have sensed Umbrasol’s disappearance, hence the reaction.
"So its reaction to a High-Level World’s disappearance is that strong, eh?"
Eisheth chuckled.
Yes, the Succubus Queen, along with the rest of the women, had appeared around him as well.
"It wasn’t just the High-Level World. We used that place as a base of operations and devoured quite a few beings by bringing them here. The Universe must have learned about them as well.
More than Umbrasol, the fact that it was fooled must be what’s making it react like this."
Amaya commented, getting nods from the rest.
"It is not safe here right now."
Nux spoke with a grim look on his face as suddenly, the women all disappeared to his Universe.
"Why do you get to stay? I am stronger than you."
Astaria complained.
"Yes, yes. Now stay there."
Nux locked his Universe, making it impossible for them to leave as he continued to observe the Main Universe’s reaction.
Something told him that it still wasn’t over.
After all, usually, by this time, the Universe’s rumbling calms down, but let alone calming down, the rumbling was getting stronger and stronger.
Even the asteroid particles that had turned into dust were trembling, as if prepared to turn back into full asteroids and explode again.
"This isn’t good."
Aeliana, who was watching everything from the screen, commented. The rest of the women beside her had the same opinion.
All of them could feel that something was about to happen—even though they had no clue what.
"I’ll go take a look."
Nux spoke up.
"Don’t be foolish."
Vyriana tried to stop him, but—

"The Necrocore should still be there. It was created out of Umbrasol Progenitor’s physique. I can get that physique if I get my hands on it. I didn’t act before because I wanted the Veil to last, but if it is no longer there, then I would like to get it before anything happens."
Nux explained.
And this time, Vyriana couldn’t say anything. After all, when it came to chasing after more strength, the Dragon had no face to say anything.
"Nux, the Supreme Worlds might be there too."
Riona spoke with a solemn look on her face.
She still remembered the first time Nux devoured a World and the Universe reacted. The beings in the Supreme Worlds reacted in an instant and connected their consciousness with the Universe.
If it wasn’t for Azriel protecting them, things could have gone out of hand.
Since then, Nux has been using Universal Energy to hide himself from their eyes every time he devours a World.

It still wasn’t known if those beings still tried the same trick after failing again and again, but considering that the Universe’s reaction was much stronger this time, Riona was sure that they would react to it.
It wouldn’t be surprising if they were already near Umbrasol.
Nux going there was extremely risky.
Hearing her words, Nux paused for a moment, then,
"...I know."
He nodded.
"I cannot always hide from them."
"Nux, you are not strong enough to face them yet. Let go."
Aeliana spoke with a solemn look on her face.
She still remembered her father’s warning, and although Nux was stronger than before, it still wasn’t time for him to face the Supreme Worlds.
"You already have the Complete Law of Absolute Death. That physique is of no help to you."
Amaya nodded as well.
And as if on cue,
"Nux, don’t be foolish."
"Come back."
The rest of the women spoke up as well. Nux sighed, and in the end, he closed his eyes and sighed.
"Send a scout instead."
Suddenly, Amaya suggested.
"We can let the scouts observe the situation. If everything looks fine, then you can leave."
"I already teleported a few. They aren’t answering now."
Nux answered.
"And you still wish to go?"
Ember raised her eyebrow, and Nux sighed,
"No."
He shook his head.

The Universe’s rumbling continued for hours, and only after 12 hours did it finally calm down.

Bzzz

It was Sharnoth.

Sharnoth questioned directly.
Yes, she was talking about Nux’s conversation with Vexarion. The Queen couldn’t care less about the historic event that had just happened and the destruction it caused throughout the Universe.
Nux grinned. He was half expecting this, so instead of answering, he showed the Seven Relics he took from Vexarion.
"Be prepared.
You will be facing Vexarion in a fair, one-on-one death battle, in 2 days."
He declared, and the moment Sharnoth heard those words, her eyes widened in surprise and then... a strong sense of relief washed over her.
Finally...
After a hundred thousand years...
She could finally get what she so desperately wanted.
The Queen closed her eyes, calming her trembling body, and then—
"Thank you, Nux Leander."
She bowed her head.
To think he made it possible.
"I have recorded the entire conversation. Do you want to see how your enemy sealed his own fate because of his greed?"
Nux offered with a playful grin. Sharnoth, of course, nodded desperately, and with a flick of Nux’s finger, a recording orb appeared in front of Sharnoth.
"Inject your energy to activate it."
Nux explained.
He wanted to continue their conversation, especially now that he could finally see the woman smile so brightly,
But suddenly—
’Lord Nux.’
Another one of his subordinates called.
’The Supreme Worlds have acted.’

sentences.text: ’Master Nux.’
One of Nux’s subordinates called out.
’What is it?’
Nux questioned with a frown.
He had placed so many subordinates in so many places that it was impossible to keep track of them all.
’Something’s wrong here.’
’Where?’
Nux questioned.
’The Reaper’s Veil.’
The instant the man said those words, Nux’s expression changed.
He, who was drifting in Outer Space, cuddling with his cats leisurely, suddenly sat up and,
’What happ—’
He tried to question, but—
It was already too late.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
The Universe reacted.
This time, much more strongly than ever before.
Even the Outer Space Nux was in, an area usually unaffected by such reactions, wasn’t spared.
BOOOM BOOOM BOOOM
Asteroids floating around burst into pieces.
The impact of their explosion travelled far and wide.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
And the Universe’s anger did not resolve here; it continued to rumble, destroying everything it could.
It felt like it was preparing to self-destruct.
It was clear how angry it was.
RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE
THUNDER THUNDER THUNDER
"Nux, what did you do?"
Thyra, who was seeing everything happen right in front of her, turned towards her husband.
She didn’t even think about there being another being capable of enraging the Universe to this level.
"I was with you the entire time..."
Nux tried to defend himself, but the cat just stared at him with her hypnotic blue eyes.
It wasn’t just her—the white cat beside her was staring at Nux with her green eyes as well.
"...let me find out what I did."
Nux just admitted it as he once again diverted his focus to the subordinate who had contacted him.
’What happened?’
He questioned again.
But...
There was no answer.
Nux narrowed his eyes.
He closed his eyes and tried to sense his subordinate’s presence, but...
He no longer existed in this Universe.
He had perished.
Nux knew he was stationed near Umbrasol so that he could inform him the moment something happened.
He tried to contact other such subordinates near Umbrasol and realized all of them had disappeared.
It didn’t take long for him to understand what had happened,
’The Universe must have attacked them.’
The instant Reaper’s Veil disappeared, the Universe must have bombed the entire area in hopes of catching the Anomaly.
Or at least that was what Nux theorized, and considering how angry the Universe was right now, it was indeed very much possible.
"What is it?"
Rune questioned.
The Universe still hadn’t stopped reacting; the trembling still continued.
She could still feel the heat of the explosions that just happened.
She contacted other subordinates planted in different regions of the Universe and realized that asteroids all over the Universe had exploded.
Only a few absurdly large asteroids were spared.
It was a major incident where billions and billions of lives were lost.
Some Low and Lowest Level Worlds were ruined completely, degrading them to their earliest state, a state with no life forms.
It was horrifying.
And...
It was safe to assume that they wouldn’t be able to have fun for now, at least not until they understood what happened, so both Rune and Thyra returned to their usual forms.
"I think something happened to the Reaper’s Veil."
Nux answered.
Even he had a solemn look on his face.
"Reaper’s Veil?"
Thyra frowned.
"Did it disappear?"
Rune questioned.
"Most likely."
Nux nodded.
"That makes sense."
Thyra muttered.
The Reaper’s Veil hid the fact that Nux had devoured Umbrasol from the Universe.
If it disappeared, then the Universe must have sensed Umbrasol’s disappearance, hence the reaction.
"So its reaction to a High-Level World’s disappearance is that strong, eh?"
Eisheth chuckled.
Yes, the Succubus Queen, along with the rest of the women, had appeared around him as well.
"It wasn’t just the High-Level World.
We used that place as a base of operations and devoured quite a few beings by bringing them here.
The Universe must have learned about them as well.
More than Umbrasol, the fact that it was fooled must be what’s making it react like this."
Amaya commented, getting nods from the rest.
"It is not safe here right now."
Nux spoke with a grim look on his face as suddenly, the women all disappeared to his Universe.
"Why do you get to stay?
I am stronger than you."
Astaria complained.
"Yes, yes.
Now stay there."
Nux locked his Universe, making it impossible for them to leave as he continued to observe the Main Universe’s reaction.
Something told him that it still wasn’t over.
After all, usually, by this time, the Universe’s rumbling calms down, but let alone calming down, the rumbling was getting stronger and stronger.
Even the asteroid particles that had turned into dust were trembling, as if prepared to turn back into full asteroids and explode again.
"This isn’t good."
Aeliana, who was watching everything from the screen, commented.
The rest of the women beside her had the same opinion.
All of them could feel that something was about to happen—even though they had no clue what.
"I’ll go take a look."
Nux spoke up.
"Don’t be foolish."
Vyriana tried to stop him, but—
"The Necrocore should still be there.
It was created out of Umbrasol Progenitor’s physique.
I can get that physique if I get my hands on it.
I didn’t act before because I wanted the Veil to last, but if it is no longer there, then I would like to get it before anything happens."
Nux explained.
And this time, Vyriana couldn’t say anything.
After all, when it came to chasing after more strength, the Dragon had no face to say anything.
"Nux, the Supreme Worlds might be there too."
Riona spoke with a solemn look on her face.
She still remembered the first time Nux devoured a World and the Universe reacted.
The beings in the Supreme Worlds reacted in an instant and connected their consciousness with the Universe.
If it wasn’t for Azriel protecting them, things could have gone out of hand.
Since then, Nux has been using Universal Energy to hide himself from their eyes every time he devours a World.

It still wasn’t known if those beings still tried the same trick after failing again and again, but considering that the Universe’s reaction was much stronger this time, Riona was sure that they would react to it.
It wouldn’t be surprising if they were already near Umbrasol.
Nux going there was extremely risky.
Hearing her words, Nux paused for a moment, then,
"...I know."
He nodded.
"I cannot always hide from them."
"Nux, you are not strong enough to face them yet.
Let go."
Aeliana spoke with a solemn look on her face.
She still remembered her father’s warning, and although Nux was stronger than before, it still wasn’t time for him to face the Supreme Worlds.
"You already have the Complete Law of Absolute Death.
That physique is of no help to you."
Amaya nodded as well.
And as if on cue,
"Nux, don’t be foolish."
"Come back."

"Send a scout instead."
Suddenly, Amaya suggested.

If everything looks fine, then you can leave."

They aren’t answering now."
Nux answered.

chapters.title: Chapter 2078: We need to think of something else.
paragraphs: ’Lord Nux.’
As Nux was talking with Sharnoth, one of his subordinates called.
’What is it?’
Nux questioned, recalling where he had placed this one.
’The Supreme Worlds have acted.’
The subordinate informed.
’What?’
Nux’s expression changed.
"What happened?"
Sharnoth questioned, instantly noticing Nux’s change.
"The Supreme Worlds, what did they do?"
Nux questioned with a grim look on his face.
"Hmm?"
Sharnoth frowned.
She hadn’t received any reports related to the matter. Just as she was about to summon her subordinate to look into the matter—
Knock Knock
She heard a knock.
"Lady Sharnoth, the Supreme World of Darkness has released an official statement."
Varys informed.

It was disrespectful, especially considering that Sharnoth hadn’t allowed him to speak yet, but considering the situation, Sharnoth did not say anything. She knew she needed to give priority to the important things first.
"Come in."
She ordered.
Varys walked in. There wasn’t any look of concern on his face, so Sharnoth could tell the statement wasn’t against her, but because Nux said what he said, she was curious to know what had happened.
"What did they say?"
She questioned.

"They want all the Mercenary Worlds to compile a report regarding every being who took the Umbrasol Mission ever since it became public. They want the report to be given manually by the Leaders of the Mercenary Companies to make sure there aren’t any dishonesties."
Varys informed.
Clearly, this wasn’t related to them, so he didn’t seem particularly worried.
"Dishonesties? Who would dare lie to them?"
Sharnoth did not understand.
"No one, but this matter seems more important than it looks. It has been a long while since all Four Supreme Worlds have come together and released a statement."
Varys gave his own opinion as he handed the scroll where the official statement was copied to Sharnoth.
"What...?"
Sharnoth’s expression changed.
"All four Supreme Worlds released a collective statement?"
She was surprised and rightfully so.
After all, this has never happened before, at least not when she was alive. The records of such a thing happening went back billions of years.
"Yes, people speculate this is related to the recent Universal Rumbling."
The Universal Rumbling was no longer a foreign concept now. It began a few thousand years ago, and while there was a small break in between, it had restarted recently.

Honestly, by now, all the worlds have gotten so used to it that they have prepared defensive measures against it. Artifacts and Relics that stabilized worlds have gotten quite popular in the Lower Level Worlds because of this, and High Level Worlds like Khaemorr were never worried about it in the first place.
This time, however, things were different.
"This one was much stronger than the others before. Even the High Level Worlds were affected. I have a hunch that the two matters are related."
Varys theorized.
Sharnoth nodded at his words. This indeed made sense.
She turned back towards Nux, who heard Varys’s report as well. Not just that, he also had all his subordinates planted all over the Universe telling him the same thing.

The Mercenary Worlds were in chaos. The World Leaders have already begun compiling reports. After all, the deadline given to them was a day, and they all knew what would happen if they failed to deliver what was required.

Some of the Low Level Mercenary Worlds who were far from the designated location where the Supreme Worlds had summoned them to, were forced to take loans and hire services of high-speed travel companies who have already sensed their chance and started their marketing campaigns.
Yes, with just one statement, the Supreme Worlds have spread chaos and panic throughout the entirety of the Universe.
That was the absurd level of power they held.
’This isn’t good.’
Riona spoke with a solemn look on her face.
The rest of the women nodded. Nux too, glanced at Sharnoth and,
"I will talk to you later."
He spoke with a solemn look on his face, and seeing his expression, Sharnoth did not stop him either.
To ease her nerves, Nux smiled at her as he then pointed at the recording orb he had given to her and,
"Don’t forget to check that. I am sure you will enjoy it."
He chuckled.
"I will."
Sharnoth smiled back as she nodded at him lightly. Nux nodded back, and as the call ended, Nux’s smile faded.
"Do you think the Fortune’s Call will be able to hide it?"
Nux questioned.
Fortune’s Call was the mercenary guild from where they took the Umbrasol Mission.
Honestly, he already knew the answer to his own question, but he still wanted to hear their words.
And just as he expected—
"No."
Amaya answered honestly.

"Only about six thousand years have passed. We were expecting the Veil to last a few more thousand years. The Leaders at the Fortune’s Call will still be the same, and they will remember everything clearly.
It would have been fine if the Supreme Worlds thought that no one would dare to lie to them and simply ordered a report instead of asking the leaders to come themselves.
They must have set up a few relics to make sure that they catch the liars. All the Mercenary Worlds and guilds, including Fortune’s Call, would have thought of that.
In front of those artifacts, they would not give a false report, even if ’a woman from one of the Supreme Worlds’ told them to."
The Devourer explained.
"We will get caught."
Amaya declared.

"They will know that the last one to take the Umbrasol Mission was a man named Nux Leander, and because of how popular the name Leander Family has become due to our actions, the connection between Nux Leander and the Leander Family will be made.
Even if it was only a coincidence, the Supreme Worlds will take this chance and try and remove the Leander Family, thinking the Anomaly is amongst them.
And of course, once we resist them, the Leander Family will be declared as public enemies and...
Vexarion will go back on his word."
Nux’s expression turned solemn.
The only reason Vexarion agreed to face Sharnoth was because he specifically told them that the Leander Family wasn’t foolish enough to go against the Supreme Worlds.
But what if it was known that the Leander Family wasindeedfoolish enough to do that?
He would realize that he was lied to. From that trail of thought, it wouldn’t be difficult for him to predict that Nux was actually planning to betray him and... he would refuse to fight Sharnoth.
Nux clenched his fists in anger.
"We went too far."
He muttered.
"We shouldn’t have used our name."
He was now regretting it.
"It wasn’t our fault.
The timing was just that unlucky.
All we needed was a symbol of fear.
If this had happened before the Leander Family name became popular, it wouldn’t have been a problem since we could have used another name.
If this had happened a few days after, it wouldn’t be a problem either, since Vexarion would already be dead and we would once again be able to change our identities.
Out of all the times the Reaper’s Veil could have vanished,
It happened exactly at the moment when it wasn’t supposed to happen."
Felberta sighed.
"It is like Fate is playing a cruel game with us."
Aeliana laughed self-deprecatingly.
Nux sighed as well.
He was frustrated. He wanted to help Sharnoth, but it seemed this was no longer possible.
"How much time do we have?"
Suddenly, Aisha questioned. The Succubus did not wish to give up.
"One day."
Amaya answered.
"Can’t we do something then?"
"Like what?"

"What if Nux teleports Sharnoth to Aurendor, right in front of Vexarion when he is not on his guard? If we get a strong attack in, it shouldn’t be difficult to take him on with Nux and Sharnoth working together, no?"
The Succubus suggested.
It was an idea worth considering. At least, that was what the women believed.
But—
"It won’t work."
Nux shook his head.
"There is a reason Vexarion is alive even though Sharnoth is stronger than him."
"Aurendor’s Will..."
Aeliana realized it.
Nux nodded.

"Sensing the enemy, Aurendor’s Will will severely weaken Sharnoth and strengthen Vexarion. The difference will be so big that once the two deploy their domains, instead of crushing each other, Vexarion’s domain would overpower Sharnoth’s.
She would lose."
This was also the reason Nux went this far to convince Vexarion. If they wanted to defeat him, they needed to pull him out of the shell he was hiding in.
There was no other way.
"...why didn’t the Aurendor’s Will weaken you then?"
Suddenly, Ember asked a question.
"Hmm?"
"You went to Aurendor to attack him as well, didn’t you? You didn’t feel any difference in strength."
"That is obvious. It happened because—"
Before Nux could complete his words, he realized what the Dragon was implying.
"You want me to devour her."
"Aurendor’s Will wouldn’t be able to weaken her then, would it?"
"It won’t."
Nux shook his head.
"But it would still be able to strengthen Vexarion.
It won’t work."
Nux’s face then turned solemn and—
"We need to think of something else."

chapters.title: Chapter 2079: He will not fight.
paragraphs: "We need to think of something else."
Nux spoke with a solemn look.

It had been a long while since this expression had appeared on his face. After all, for a long while, he was always in control of the situation. Even if he wasn’t, at the very least, he knew nothing was going to stop him from getting what he wanted.
But now, he couldn’t see any way out.
Defeating Vexarion before the Supreme Worlds declare the Leander Family as the common enemy of the Universe seemed impossible.
With Vexarion’s nature, he would never leave that shell that protected him no matter what. Nux thought about countless scenarios or ways to pull him out in his mind, but none worked.
Not when they only had a day in their hand.
"Let’s contact Sharnoth first."
Suddenly, Felberta spoke up, instantly attracting everyone’s attention.
"What?"
Aeliana frowned.
"Why her?"
Amaya narrowed her eyes as well.
"She does not know anything about this."
The First Wife answered.
"She has no need to know this."
Amaya countered.
"She does."
Felberta did not back down. She stared at her sisters and,
"You know her situation. You have seen it with your own eyes.
Someone like her, an Eternal who could have all the glory she wanted, was prepared to submit herself to Nux just so she could have her revenge.
She even accepted Zylarith’s help, knowing that he was up to no good, for the sake of her revenge.
She needs to know this.
Actually, she needs to know this more than any of us.

She dedicated her entire life to her revenge. This is the only goal she has, her dream, her only wish. Nux appeared and showed that this dream of hers can become a reality, giving her a glimmer of hope when she was full of despair—
But now that the glimmer of hope she had seen was on the verge of flickering away, she, at the very least, deserves the right to be part of this conversation.
And who knows?
She might even have a way out, no?"
The Eldraeth smiled lightly, and the rest of the women staring at her could not deny her words.
"...alright."
Even Amaya had no choice but to give in.
With the same smile, Felberta turned towards Nux, who nodded and activated the artifact. Sharnoth picked his call on the first ring, her face looked much more excited than before,
"Nux Leander! I thank you from the bottom of my heart!"
She bowed her head.
Her always solemn face now had a lovely smile.
It seemed that the woman had watched the recording Nux gave her.

Yes, she was prepared. She was finally going to crush that light bastard who destroyed her world and subjected her and her mother to humiliation so strong that her mother wished to die than to leave that place with her.
Sharnoth’s heart boiled in rage when she recalled her mother’s red tears as she requested her to kill her.
Sharnoth’s crimson eyes shined,
She will kill that bastard!
She will kill him in the most painful way possible!
She swore in her heart once again!
But suddenly—
"Sharnoth."
Nux called out.
"Deploy your domain, make sure no one is around you."
He instructed.
Seeing the solemn look on his face, Sharnoth did not ask for any explanation and simply did what she was told instead.
The domain was created. Sharnoth, as the Absolute Being in her domain, made it so that no one other than her could remain in here.
Once everything was done, she glanced at Nux and—
"The Supreme Worlds are after me."
Nux revealed.
Sharnoth’s expression changed.
"...what?"
She questioned.
"The Umbrasol Mission, I was the last one who took it."
"What are you talking about?"
Sharnoth did not understand.

The Queen was too excited imagining different ways to kill that bastard. She had come up with several torture methods, especially after seeing the recording Nux sent her—so much that she didn’t even bother sending anyone to investigate what this matter was all about.
After all, this matter wasn’t related to her, she had nothing to do with it.
Or at least—
That was what she believed.
But—
"The recent Universe’s reaction, it happened because the Reaper’s Veil that surrounded Umbrasol disappeared."
Nux began explaining.
Sharnoth listened attentively. For some reason, she felt like she wouldn’t like where this was going.
"The Reaper’s Veil had a strong power, a power to hide everything that happened inside it."
Sharnoth nodded.
She knew about this a little. Umbrasol’s case was quite popular.
"The Veil was so strong that even the Universe’s Will wasn’t able to sense what it was hiding."
"What...?"
Sharnoth couldn’t believe it.
Was that even possible?
Didn’t the Universe know everything?
There were several questions in her head, but for now, she remained silent.
"When I went to Umbrasol a few thousand years ago, I devoured Umbrasol."
Nux revealed, and now—
—Sharnoth was even more confused.
"You... devoured Umbrasol?"
She couldn’t understand it.
Didn’t he just say the Universe wouldn’t know what happens inside the Reaper’s Veil?
How could one devour a world without the Universe’s help?
After all, it was the Universe that actually devoured the world. The Universe is the one who takes the destroyed world and uses its energy to create another world.
This is how it has always been; everyone knew that.
"I have the ability to devour worlds, all on my own."
Nux revealed.
"Nux, what are you talking about?"
Sharnoth spoke with a solemn look on her face.

"I can devour worlds. I can take them away from the Universe’s influence and use their energy for myself. From a certain perspective, you can say that I have the ability tostealworlds from the Universe.
And every time I do this, the Universe reacts violently."
"Wait...
Does this mean..."
"Yes, all this while, every time the Universe reacted, it was because I took something that belonged to it."
Nux nodded, and Sharnoth’s eyes widened in fright.
Just what in the hell was this man talking about!? How could something like this be possible!?
Stealing from the... Universe?
How does this make any sense!?

"It first began about six thousand years ago when I first devoured a Lowest Level World, and from then on, I have been going against the Universe, devouring different Lowest, Low, or Middle Level Worlds. I even devoured people, and every time I did it, the Universe reacted—though the reactions later got tamer since it slowly got used to it and stopped reacting to people."
"You can devour people too?"
"I can.
This is also the reason you cannot sense my subordinates like Maeve. They are no longer part of the Universe—I stole them."
"You... stole them..."
Sharnoth could only repeat those words dumbfoundedly.
She had no clue what Nux was talking about. There were thousands of things she couldn’t understand.
For now, however, she suppressed the rest of her doubts and focused on the important situation,
"So when you devoured Umbrasol..."
"The Reaper’s Veil hid it, and the Universe wasn’t able to find out about this."
Nux nodded.

"Once I noticed it, I realized that as long as I did what I did inside the Reaper’s Veil, the Universe wouldn’t be able to react to it. So from then on, I started devouring people inside the Reaper’s Veil.
But now..."
"Now that the Reaper’s Veil is gone, the Universe found out about everything."
The Queen guessed, and Nux nodded with a solemn look on his face.
"It feels cheated, hence such a strong reaction."
"...and how do the Supreme Worlds come into play here?
Why are they after you?"
"Why wouldn’t they be?"
Nux questioned back, and very quickly, Sharnoth’s expression changed.
Of course they would be after him! The power Nux had was something beyond anything she had ever heard of before.
Even her ’master’ did not mention anything like this.
The power to go against the very Universe—it was far beyond the power of Chaos or any other Supreme Powers everyone else knew about.
It was obvious the Supreme Worlds would be after him because he had such powers.
"The Leaders of the Supreme Worlds have the power to connect their consciousness to the Universe and are able to tell why it is reacting in this manner.
Usually, I am able to hide everything from them so they do not know what happened and which world I devoured, barely avoiding them.
But this time..."
"Because the Reaper’s Veil disappeared on its own, you couldn’t hide it and the Supreme Worlds got a lead."
Sharnoth completed his sentence, and Nux nodded,
"And they decided to act on the first lead they got in thousands of years."
"So this was the reason I sensed urgency and desperation from the statement they released..."
Sharnoth muttered.
"I foolishly used my name when I took the Umbrasol Mission. If the Supreme Worlds investigate, they will find out about it and with our recent actions..."
"The Leander Family will be highlighted.
The Supreme Worlds will declare you people as enemies and...
Vexarion will no longer believe you.
So he will not fight."
Sharnoth spoke with a grim look on her face, and Nux...
"Yes."
He nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 2080: Let’s become terrorists.
paragraphs: "The Leander Family will be highlighted.
The Supreme Worlds will declare you people as enemies and...
Vexarion will no longer believe you."
Sharnoth spoke with a grim look on her face.
"Yes."
Nux nodded at those words. His expression was similar to Sharnoth’s.
"It will take a day before we are declared as their enemies, so we need to act before that."
He spoke.
"Have you thought of a way to stop this?"
Sharnoth questioned, and Nux shook his head.
"We have nothing till now."
Nux then passed a wry smile and,
"I am still cursing our luck. If only this had happened a few days later."
At those words, Sharnoth frowned,
"...what would have changed in a few days?"
She could not understand.

It wasn’t like the Leander Family could have gotten strong enough to take on the Supreme Worlds within just a few days. If that was possible, all of this wouldn’t have been a problem in the first place.
"What do you mean? If this didn’t happen, we could have killed Vexarion two days later."
Nux answered.
"Huh?"
Sharnoth frowned.
"Huh?"
And Nux was the same.
The two stared at each other in confusion, and then—
"You are still worried about killing Vexarion?"
Sharnoth raised her eyebrow.
"I did promise you your revenge, didn’t I?"
Nux answered as if it was the most obvious thing in the world.
"The Supreme Worlds are going to come after you and you are worried about keeping your promise?"
Sharnoth questioned, and for an instant, Nux turned silent.
Just what in the hell...
Soon, however, he realized something.
Sharnoth, she had been betrayed so many times, that she never expected the help in the first place.

Sure, the recording and everything Nux did so far gave her a sliver of hope, hope that something might happen, but the instant she realized that the Supreme Worlds were after Nux and the Leander Family, that hope was gone.
He already had so much to deal with, how is he going to help me?
It was a simple, even logical thought process, but...
It felt pitiful.

For a moment, Nux just stared at this woman in front of him—a woman who knew she wouldn’t survive long now that she had revealed the Power of Chaos, yet the only thing that kept her going was her wish for revenge, and now, even the hope of that long wished revenge was gone.
In the end, Nux heaved a big sigh and,
"The Supreme Worlds were going to become our enemies anyways. This isn’t about the Supreme Worlds coming after us. They cannot harm us, at least not till we try to actively fight them."
He spoke carefully. His words made Sharnoth blink in surprise.
Just what sort of confidence does one need to say such words out loud?
Oblivious to her thoughts, Nux continued,
"Supreme Worlds do not matter.
This is about Vexarion. The moment this happens, he will once again hide in that shell of yours.
No, actually, he would reveal that you and the Leander Family are working together, and the Supreme Worlds will come look for you instead."
"I am not scared of them."
Sharnoth declared without missing a beat.
"Aren’t you scared of not being able to take your revenge?"
At those words, Sharnoth turned silent.
She had already lost her will to get revenge, especially after everything that was happening. It felt like the very Universe was against her getting her revenge. She felt... powerless.
But...
"Don’t worry. You will have your revenge. I will not go back on my words. I just need some time to think."
Nux spoke, and seeing the look on his face,
The sliver of hope that had just died reignited.
For some reason, when she saw Nux still thinking about different ways to kill Vexarion, even in the face of the Supreme Worlds, she felt like this was actually possible.
"There is a way to kill him."
Suddenly, Amaya, who had been silent all this while, spoke up, instantly attracting all the attention. Sharnoth frowned. After all, she could only see Nux on the screen.
Nux realized it as well,
"Right, I still haven’t introduced you to the most precious people in my life, have I?"
He smiled as suddenly, the screen Sharnoth was seeing widened, revealing nineteen beautiful women standing beside Nux.
"These are my wives."
Nux spoke with a smile so big that it made Sharnoth freeze.
"They are the people I fight for, people I could do anything for, people I wish to spend the rest of Eternity with.
She is..."
One by one, Nux started introducing all his wives. The smile on his face when he talked about them was so pure that it felt like his previous frown was just an illusion.
In her mind, Sharnoth felt like every time she saw this man smile, it was merely an act, because none of his smiles ever got close to what she was seeing right now.
It stirred a... strange emotion inside her.
She felt... jealous?
Of course, as soon as that thought appeared, she suppressed it in an instant and greeted those women politely.
The women smiled at her, especially the white-haired succubus. She... she was looking at her with a strange smile on her face.
Almost as if... she was looking at prey.
It made Sharnoth feel somewhat uncomfortable, but she didn’t say anything out loud and decided to ignore her for now.
Seeing her reaction, Allura just chuckled. She gently patted her belly without saying anything else.
"Now, the one who said there is a way to kill Vexarion—this is Amaya. She is my little strategist, someone I can trust with my eyes closed."
Nux introduced with a big smile, oblivious to the little exchange between Sharnoth and his Allura.
His focus was on Amaya. The devourer, however, stared at him and spoke directly,
"As I was saying, I have a way to kill him, but you will not like it."
"What? Why?"
Nux frowned.
"It will be painless."
Amaya shrugged.
She knew her man.
She knew what he was planning. The last thing in Nux’s mind was giving Vexarion an easy death. Knowing Nux, this was actually a gift to Vexarion, not a punishment.
And just as Amaya thought, the instant he heard those words, Nux scowled, even more than Sharnoth herself. It was almost as if he wanted to torture that bastard more than Sharnoth.
"What is the way?"

Unable to control herself, Sharnoth questioned, looking at Amaya. She had noticed the woman glaring at her before, as if she was her most hated enemy. She did not understand why, but for now, she knew she needed to focus on what was more important.
"We can use the Universe."
Amaya answered, looking at Nux, knowing that he would understand what she was talking about.
After all, they had done this before.
"Using the Universe...?"
Of course, Sharnoth had no clue what the woman was talking about.
"Do you think it would work?"
Nux questioned.
"The Universe is angry because it was fooled, wasn’t it? If we act quickly enough, we can use that anger and direct it towards Aurendor."
Amaya answered.
"It could work... but there is no guarantee that Vexarion will die."
Nux muttered, nodding at her words.
"Isn’t that even better? With Aurendor gone, he would no longer have the shell to hide in. We can then do whatever we desire."
A smile appeared on Nux’s face when he heard those words.
"But this means we would be leaving it to chance, and we stand at the lower side of the probability. It is much more likely that he will die painlessly."
Amaya explained, and honestly, Nux wasn’t very fond of the idea. It left things to luck, and considering everything that had been happening, Lady Luck wasn’t exactly on his side.
While the two conversed, Sharnoth stared at them in silence.
She felt... alienated.

Like she wasn’t part of the discussion. The distance between Nux and her felt larger than usual, and for some reason, every time she stared at the woman named Amaya, she had this strange feeling that the woman knew exactly what she was feeling and was enjoying it.
Almost as if... she was making a statement.
It was quite confusing, especially considering Sharnoth had never felt like this before.
"We need something else..."
And again, while Sharnoth explored all these new, frustrating emotions, Nux muttered out loud, lowering his head.
He needed a better plan.
"What if we try and buy more time?"
Suddenly, Melia spoke up.
"Hmm?"
Nux turned towards her and the Vampire continued,
"We can destroy Nexus and the Fortune’s Call.
That should buy us some time."

"But that will only bring more focus to Mercenary Guilds present in Nexus. It wouldn’t be long before information that the Fortune’s Call had was extracted. This might actually hasten the entire process."
Ember shook her head.
Melia thought about it for a moment, then,
"Let’s become terrorists."
The Vampire suggested.
